name: Reality Kitchen
description: A chaotic culinary space where chefs cook meals from every dimension. Stoves burn with blue flame, red flame, and existential dread. The walk-in freezer is dimensionally transcendent (bigger on the inside). Pots boil with soups from alien worlds. The sous chef is literally a robot, the line cook is a ghost, and the dishwasher is something that shouldn't exist. Menu items include: 'Quantum Quiche' (exists in all states until ordered), 'Grandfather Paradox Pie,' and 'Wednesday Soup' (it's always Wednesday in here).
